jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

Back then, we brought the legendary sushi conveyor belt to Germany, bringing a real pioneering spirit to the restaurant scene. Our roots? High-quality ingredients, craftsmanship, and fine cuisine made with love.Today, Sushi Circle is established in Germany and Eastern Europe: two restaurants and over 300 sushi islands in supermarkets. And the best part? Our sushi is rolled fresh every day, right on site – with a lot of love and over 25 years of experience. jobs.occupation: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG: Experienced Program Manager 22FDX (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
jobs.employer_name: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your Job- You will be the responsible Program Manager for Technology Development Programs within GlobalFoundries' state-of-the-art 300 mm wafer fab (Fab1) in Dresden, Germany.- Plan and manage the execution for complex semiconductor engineering development programs.- Own the overall program schedule, resource allocation and alignment of program Milestone deliverables.- Ensure seamless transition from development phase into production.- Lead a cross-functional team of experts throughout the entire Technology Development Program defining tasks & work packages for in-time & in-quality program completion.- Work closely with Product Management, PMO, PDK, Modeling and IP Teams.- Communicate effectively internally as well as with customers within technical and executive forums. Required Qualifications- Masters/ Diploma degree in Engineering or Science (e.g. Physics, Chemistry, Materials) and/ or PhD.- Solid working knowledge of modern CMOS process integration.- Being a teamplayer with good oral and written communication skills in English are required.- Strong analytical, problem solving and project management skills.- You must have several years of experience in technical leadership roles within the semiconductor industry.- Track record in Technology Development and/or program management of complex, cross-functional engineering programs.- Experience in “More than Moore” development efforts like Embedded Memory, High-Voltage or RF/mmWave are a plus.- Fluent in English Language – written & verbal, Proficiency in German language is a plus.- Exposure to semiconductor volume manufacturing methods, statistical methods, FMEA/8D Methodology, external customer & multicultural working environment is beneficial.- Project Management Certification (eg. IPMA, PMP) is a plus.We Offer  The position is open-ended and to be filled as soon as possible.  Attractive compensation components:   13th month salary, bonus payments, assistance with relocation to Dresden.  Flexible working time arrangements:   Family friendly part-time models, trust flextime, salary conversion into free time  Diverse opportunities for further development:   Career stages for every job, internal qualification offers, promotion of external educational qualifications  Focus on your health:   On-site gym and beach volleyball court, bike leasing, subsidized employee restaurant  Corporate culture:   Cooperation at eye level - everyone is on first name terms with us, budget for individual team events, social commitment via GlobalGives  You can find more benefits in detail at  hier  Diversity is part of our corporate DNA. For this reason, we would like to encourage women in particular to apply for a job with us. As we value equal opportunities and inclusion is particularly important to us, we welcome applications from people with disabilities.The job advertisement refers to a position up to job level 8 on the Engineering career ladder.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: Englisch, RF, HF, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309601/experienced-program-manager-22fdx#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. Wir sind innovativ und arbeiten mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um energieeffizientere und leistungsfähigere Produkte für die Automobilindustrie, intelligente mobile Geräte, das Internet der Dinge (IoT), Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen und andere wachstumsstarke Märkte zu entwickeln.Mit unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk, das sich über die USA, Europa und Asien erstreckt, sind wir eine vertrauenswürdige und zuverlässige Quelle für Kunden in aller Welt. Jeden Tag liefert unser talentiertes und vielfältiges Team Ergebnisse mit einem unnachgiebigen Fokus auf Sicherheit, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. GF beschäftigt weltweit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitende, davon 3.000 in Dresden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.gf.com.

TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in Germany. Founded in 1828, today it is a globally oriented, regionally anchored top university and focuses on the grand challenges of the 21st century. The **TRR404 “Next Generation Electronics With Active Devices in Three Dimensions [Active-3D]”** is a Collaborative Research Center/Transregio between TUD and Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule Aachen (RWTH Aachen) funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft. The TRR aims at exploring a completely new approach for microelectronics technology and therefore teams up materialists, electrical engineers, and computer scientists of TUD, RWTH Aachen and Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mikro- und Optoelektronik mbH (AMO (https://www.amo.de/en/) ) in Aachen, Forschungszentrum Jülich (FZJ (https://www.fz-juelich.de/en) ), Max Planck Institute of Microstructure Physics Halle (MPI-MSP (https://www.mpi-halle.mpg.de/home) ), Nanoelectronic Materials Laboratory gGmbH (NaMLab (https://www.namlab.com/) ) in Dresden, Ruhr-Universität Bochum (RUB (https://www.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/en) ).For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The TRR404 offers a position asResearch Associate / Postdoc (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is limited untilDecember 31, 2028. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually habilitation thesis). Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application.Position:                  TRR404-TUD-A07-PDProject:                     A07 Vertical Perovskite Field-Effect TransistorsProject Leader:    Prof. Yana Vaynzof (https://tu-dresden.de/ing/elektrotechnik/ihm/emsol)  (Chair of Emerging Electronic Technologies)Tasks: - fabrication, characterization and optimization of devices and the study of their stability including experimental work, data analysis, preparation of reports, publications and dissemination of results.Requirements: - excellent university degree (master or comparable) and PhD degree in physics or electrical engineering- above-average degree achieved in short study period- willingness and ability to think beyond the boundaries of your field, to act in an international and diverse environment and to live an open and constructive communication- strong analytic and problem-solving skills, creativity- an independent, target- and solution-driven work attitude- fluency in English, knowledge of German would be a plusWhat we offer:A varied and challenging research task, embedded in a friendly, inclusive and supportive team of the TRR’s Principal Investigators (i.e., project leaders and supervisors). We maintain an open and cooperative work attitude with maximum personal responsibility, mutual support with a solution-oriented approach, and flexible working hours where possible. As Postdoc you may become a member of TUD Postdoc center. It offers tailored educational programs and counseling. In addition, TUD offers: - employment in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement for the public service of the Länder (TV-L)- an individual assignment of the collective agreement experience level taking into account your previous professional experience- 30 days annual vacation and annual bonus payment (restrictions apply)- additional pension scheme (VBL)- very good accessibility by public transport- car parking facilities- state-of-the-art buildings with labs equipped to a high technical standard- a wide range of offers for health promotion and for the compatibility of family and career- numerous opportunities for further training, including language courses, IT courses and other courses TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application including a motivation letter, CV, copy of degree certificate, transcript of grades (i.e., the official list of coursework including your grades) and proof of English language skills, by December 1, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/) by sending it as a single pdf file quoting the reference number TRR404-TUD-A07-PD in the subject header to recruiting.cfaed@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:recruiting.cfaed@tu-dresden.de)  or to:TU Dresden, cfaed/TRR404, Dr. Schneider, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany. Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Elektrotechnik, Forschung, Datenanalyse, Physik, Berichtswesen, Information

jobs.description: About GF  GlobalFoundries® Inc. (GF®) is one of the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers.
